description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Api' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketplace'. The class extends a system controller and provides two main methods: 'index' for displaying the API view, and 'save' for handling API settings updates, including permission checks, input validation, and JSON response generation.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for handling marketplace API operations, including displaying the API page and saving API configuration settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language resources, prepares data with user token from session, and renders the 'marketplace/api' view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles permission checks and saves API-related settings from POST data. Returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.
